statement: SDL 3.2.0 Xbox 360 HIDAPI eligibility requires SDL_GAMEPAD_TYPE_XBOX360, rejects the 045e:0719 wireless receiver and chatpad interfaces >0; on macOS typically defers wired controllers to GCController except Steam virtual exception. SDL hidapijoystick chooses a matching enabled driver via IsSupportedDevice, so standard-HID presentation cannot be assumed to run its XUSB decoder from VID/PID alone.
